content.thinking:
The test takes too long (the brute-force oracle over 700 seeds with 5 requests and 5 offers can be expensive: C(25,5) etc.). Let me reduce the number of seeds and limit the pair count, and run in the background or with fewer iterations.

Let me time a single iteration and reduce to ~200 seeds.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
src=open('tmp/t_random2.py').read()
src=src.replace("for seed in range(700):","import time\nT0=time.time()\nLIMIT=150\nfor seed in range(LIMIT):")
src=src.replace("""print('adversarial comparison done, failures:',fails)""",
"""    if time.time()-T0>120:
        print('stopped early at seed',seed); break
print('adversarial comparison done, failures:',fails)""")
open('tmp/t_random2.py','w').write(src)
PYEOF
timeout 170 python3 /workspace/tmp/t_random2.py 2>&1 | tail -8
